definitions: To give someone permission to do something, often with a hint of sarcasm or indifference, implying that the speaker doesn't care about the outcome.
To exert oneself to the point of exhaustion or injury.
examples: You want to stay up all night playing video games? Knock yourself out!
He's going to knock himself out trying to finish that project by tomorrow.
If you think you can fix it, knock yourself out.
